craft_notes: Sthāyin: assimilation-shock. Rows: shake then settle. Rejected: normalizing kṣubhnāty — killed: flagged anomaly, sense kept. Read aloud: jolt then rest.

lines: The tremor of throbbing entry to that pair's high home
shakes the lesser wheels as well — then That-made, no more apart.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tadyugalamūrdhvadhāmapraveśasaspandajātasaṃkṣobham kṣubhnāty anucakrāṇy api tāni tadā tanmayāni na pṛthak tu
